note: CB-S1 / CB-S5: Swift has no builder of its own (engine/src/build/lang_build.rs build_solo sends it to build_typescript). Inside a method an unqualified call names the enclosing type's member before any free function, and every file of a module sees every type of the module without an import. HEAD 2170ff8 (`[evidence-graph] calls ... module_symbol=2`): BOTH `helper()` calls bind the free function Sources::App::Pricing::helper through the module symbol - the one in Cart::checkout, and the one in the `extension Cart` of Cart+Tax.swift (its method walks up to the one Cart node, whose nav parent is Pricing.swift); `Formatter.money(n)` on a type declared in another file binds nothing.

expect_edges.note: implicit self: the member wins over the same-file free function
an extension in another file shares the type's members
static call on a same-module type declared in another file

forbid.note: what HEAD binds: the same-file free function shadows nothing inside a member
what HEAD binds from the extension: the free function reached through the class's nav parent file
